raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task by treating it as finding the end year of a specific governor’s term (especially around 1963) rather than identifying that the office of “Governor of Vatican City” itself ended in 1952. This misframing led to repetitive confirmation of the death place and no targeted search for the office’s end year, steering the solution path in the wrong direction.
